From: alex.martinez@redwood.com

Subject: Re: SIG follow-up — data retention / prompt logs / training proof

Maria — appreciate the clear asks. Summary answers below; attaching a brief evidence pack and the completed SIG answers sheet in my next email (submitting now to allow time for your review):

1) Retention windows:
- Prompt interactions / request/response logs: default 30 days for hosted customers; configurable windows: 24 hours, 7 days, 30 days, or customer-managed deletion for most Dedicated/Private deployments.
- Structured telemetry and metrics (latency, costs): 365 days.
- Audit & billing records: 7 years (per enterprise contract).

2) Training / use of customer prompts:
- Hosted API: customer data is not used to train our public model snapshots by default. We offer a documented opt-in program for customers who explicitly authorize training contributions; this is governed by an explicit contract clause and an API flag.
- Dedicated & Private deployments: no customer data leaves the customer-controlled environment unless explicitly configured. No training occurs on customer data unless the customer requests and provisions it.

3) Log format & TTL markers: attached sample (evidence_logs_sample.txt) shows a redacted request entry with a ttl_seconds field and a deletion_status tag. We also include an internal process note on irreversible deletion and proof-of-deletion markers.

We'll attach: Redwood_SIG_Answers_20270303.xlsx (completed answers), evidence_logs_sample.txt (redacted sample), and a signed training attestation PDF. If you'd like a small Zoom to walk through the artifacts, Marissa and I can do a 30-min slot tomorrow.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Customer Security Lead | Redwood Inference

Team — follow-up with the specifics you requested:

1) Opt-in flag & contract reference:
- API header: X-Redwood-Training-Consent: true (boolean-like string). When present on a dataset ingestion or fine-tuning request it is recorded in our immutable ingestion ledger.
- Contract clause: Section 9.2 (Data Use for Model Improvement) in our standard enterprise addendum; we can append customer-specific amendments if needed.

2) Deletion receipts / proof-of-deletion:
- For hosted customers we generate a deletion receipt object that includes the record_id, deletion_timestamp (ISO 8601), and a SHA256 hash of the deletion event. Receipts are available via the audit API (GET /v1/audit/deletions?customer_id=) for up to 90 days after deletion; longer-term retention of the receipts is possible under enterprise contracts and exportable as signed artifacts. The evidence_logs_sample.txt includes a deletion_receipt example (redacted ids) and an audit API snippet.

3) Signed attestation:
- Attached: training-attestation-signed.pdf signed by Soojin Lee, Head of Security & Compliance (Redwood Inference). The PDF includes signatory name, title, and date.

If you want we can also produce a short recorded screen walkthrough of the deletion receipt flow (10 mins) and upload it to your Drive folder. Marissa — can you confirm the audit API retention defaults and whether we can export receipts for >90 days for HB?

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Customer Security Lead | Redwood Inference
